mixed.label: Clean cards
mixed.question: Mix of face only, a card with your face in a rounded window, and full-screen cards. Serif key-word captions.
mixed.caption: duo
mixed.graphics: title card at frame 1; card or card + face every 2-4 s (diagram, checklist, counter, prompt, step header); icon stickers over the face for tools and objects; comment CTA at the end
mixed.tagline: Cards with your face in a window, key words in serif

studio.label: Bold B-roll
studio.question: Warm cinematic face, a hook title band, full-screen B-roll with big numbers for each point, stacked-word captions, glowing comment CTA and an end card.
studio.caption: stack
studio.graphics: 0-4 s: B-roll or device mock-up on top + band overlay (green l1, italic l2) at the seam, face below; then face full frame; every listed point = full-screen B-roll (user clips/screenshots, else device mock-up) 2.5-5 s with a bignum overlay; ctaword overlay on the 'comment X' line; endcard (2-5 s, black) last
studio.tagline: Hook title band, big numbers on phone shots, stacked words

simple.label: Face and captions
simple.question: Your face the whole time with zoom-ins, word-highlight captions and a title. Quickest to make.
simple.caption: karaoke
simple.graphics: title on frame 1; one or two chapter word cards; counter for numbers; nothing else
simple.tagline: Your face all the way, zoom-ins, word-highlight captions
